description: A mark on a non-function declaration binds to nothing, and the message names the enclosing function.

diagnostics.message: `@nothrow` binds to nothing here. The nearest valid site is the function `attempt` on line 1. A mark binds on a function declaration, a single-declarator variable statement with a function or arrow initializer, a class method, constructor or accessor, or an object-literal method or function-valued property.
